security_justification.audit_integrity: Configured validation alone governs instance admission; a process-wide override cannot refuse or weaken named events.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: Existing semantic authorization checks retain their exact order and diagnostics; runtime selection introduces no authorization bypass.
security_justification.authority_provenance: The normalized instance configuration is runtime authority; operation handles and derived-field provenance retain their existing checks.
security_justification.concurrency: No global swaps or new mutable state; independent instances keep their own runtime while the free function retains the global default.
security_justification.confidentiality: No event values or provider errors enter new diagnostics; existing safe result sanitization remains unchanged.
security_justification.cryptography: No identifiers, algorithms, keys or signatures change; default cryptographic provider behavior stays intact.
security_justification.error_disclosure: Preserve bounded schema verdict reconstruction and exact existing code/category/path triples; no new error surface.
security_justification.external_security_integration: Node receives error-catalog clarification only; contract and collector behavior are unchanged.
security_justification.fail_posture: Configured runtime faults still fail closed before sink handoff; already-validated delivery is private and unavailable to callers.
security_justification.lifecycle: Preserve ready-state checks before validation and handoff, duplicate completion reservations and settlement/release behavior.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: Only existing named seams and private delivery change; re-anchor affected mutants without weakening and run the full verification suite.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: Named transformations precede the same validation pipeline; prohibited-data and post-transformation scans retain ordering.
security_justification.resource_retention: No cache, brand store, event ledger or additional retained state is needed to avoid revalidation.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: Named redelivery validates once with configured authority while retaining event identity, binding checks and identifier/clock bypass.
security_justification.trust_boundary: Instance configuration, not process-global override, governs instance admission; free validation keeps its explicit/default selection boundary.
